text:
Elliot M: LAN tourney this Friday? Thinking Smash Ultimate + TowerFall if we can round up 4-8 players. Low-key bracket, winner gets the last box of office cereal. :trophy: :cereal_box:

Priya K: I'm in for Smash. Can someone bring a spare Pro Controller or a Joy-Con set?

Diego R: I have a Switch + dock and one Pro controller. Also a GC adapter if people want melee controllers.

Elliot M: Awesome. @Diego R bringing the adapter would be clutch. Jonas, you streaming?

Jonas L: Yeah I can stream a few matches to the #random feed. Need a capture card though  anyone have a spare HDMI capture?

Priya K: I can borrow a cheap USB capture from home, works fine for 720p.

Maya (events): partybot:poll "Game pick" "Smash Ultimate" "TowerFall" "Jackbox"

partybot: Poll created: "Game pick" 1 votes: Smash Ultimate (3), TowerFall (1)

Elliot M: Smash wins. Quick signup: list below, I'll make a tiny challonge bracket.

Priya K: signup: Priya K

Diego R: signup: Diego R

Jonas L: signup: Jonas L (streaming, maybe playing too)

Elliot M: signup: Elliot M

Maya (events): Signup form posted in the event thread with time + roof access code. Start at 6:30?

Elliot M: 6:30 is perfect. Logistics: need 2 power strips, extension cord, and a TV or projector. Anyone bring a small table?

Diego R: I can bring a 32\" TV and an HDMI cable. Also two extra controllers.

Priya K: I'll bring a power strip and snacks (salty). :chip:

Jonas L: For stream overlay, drop any highlight clips in this thread afterwards. I'll cut a 30s recap.

Elliot M: For controller input lag: switch the TV to game mode and set console to wired controllers when possible. 

Maya (events): Friendly reminder: keep volume reasonable, floor below is open office. Also wear shoes on the roof.

Priya K: One more thing 1 who wants to volunteer to run the bracket on challonge? I can do it if Elliot is driving setup.

Elliot M: I can host the bracket. I'll post the link ~1 hour before start.

Diego R: See you Friday! :smiley:
